tei:div.tei:p: (285)(286) hūm̐/ dpal chen rdo rje gro bo lod// stag tshang seng ge'i bsam 'grub tu// gdug pa'i dam sri 'dul ba bzhin// khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab// sgrub mchog rnal 'byor bdag cag gis// dur khrod rdzas la brten bcas te// gdung ba drag pos rgyud bskul na// thugs rje chen pos 'dir dgongs shig /phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol// oṃ badzra shrī gro bo lod sarba siddhi hūm̐: mi kha bsgyur dril thum rbad ma ra ya phaṭa/
byad kha bzlog dang mi kha bsgyur// dam sri 'dul dang sde brgyad gzhom// las tshogs (sgrub )rnams zur du gsal//
